semantic.movementPresentationNote: The index, middle, ring and pinky fingers extend and flex down 2 times, returning toward extension between flexions; the timing is authored for this avatar prototype and is not source timing evidence. Their lateral spacing stays even while they flex and is narrowed to 85% of the open-hand spread.
semantic.handshapePresentationNote: Extended fingers use a 1.8 lateral landmark spread factor and a 18-degree rig splay for visual clarity in this avatar prototype; this is not regional performance evidence.
semantic.locationPresentationNote: The active hand is placed high beside the avatar face and offset to its screen-right side, not centered in front of the face; this is a constructed avatar placement, not regional performance evidence.
semantic.realizationNote: Constructed avatar draft from the cited LSC numeral description; not a recorded regional performance.
semantic.timingNote: Prototype transition and hold duration for renderer review; not source timing evidence.

publicationReview.scope: The moving finger configuration follows the cited dictionary description; avatar timing and regional realization are not professionally validated.
